svg.aria-label: th3-skills: Claude Code skills, each doing a whole job. poc-spec-driven-builder: proves an idea, tests first. In: “Can tickets sync to a sheet?”. Out: spec, test matrix, build, a PR with the proof. design-core: design rules, scored by a critic. In: a screen the author scored 9.8. Out: critic: 6.1, fix, re-score, 9.4: passes the 9.2 bar. design-flow: Figma screens with their flow. In: a live page or its HTML. Out: an editable Figma screen, its flowchart beside it. prompt-cache-kit: cheaper agent runs. In: agent briefs that differ from the first byte. Out: one identical prefix, so the prompt cache hits. thai-mock-naming: mock names that are fake on sight. In: a test user who looks like a real person. Out: a marker name: fake on sight, one grep finds every row. dependency-vuln-explainer: does this CVE reach you?. In: a Dependabot alert, CVSS 10.0. Out: traced through the lockfile: not reachable, priority low. qa: QA evidence and reports. In: a Q&A sheet, export buttons, an Excel import, a ticket. Out: remarks, an evidence .xlsx, a test run, a Jira report. devops: infra changes with a report. In: a change on a real server. Out: plan, approved steps, checks, before / after / rollback. doc-style-builder: docs in one house style. In: a Markdown file. Out: PDF + DOCX in the house theme, changes highlighted. pdf-operations: merge, split, rotate, stamp. In: three separate PDFs. Out: one PDF, pages reordered, rotated and stamped. containers: wins back Podman disk. In: a disk full of old images. Out: pruned, trimmed, the WSL disk compacted: space back.
